subject: Post-term usage remediation and one-time top-up offer — SableTech
messages:
From: Luke Emerson <luke.emerson@sabletech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: SableTech Procurement <procurement@sabletech.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Q2 burst — need reconciliation and proposed fix

Hi Karthik / Naomi,

Hope you're both well. We've finished our own internal review of June's traffic and discovered a sustained burst of inference-hours that landed ~38% above our committed monthly capacity for the last billing window (see attached). This was post-renewal and outside our normal seasonal variance.

We want to avoid escalation but need to reconcile the delta and understand options for one-time settlements vs. adjusting future commits. Two asks: 1) Can Redwood provide a line-item reconciliation for the overage hours and an estimated one-time charge? 2) If we agree to a one-time top-up, can Redwood offer any goodwill credit given onboarding gaps we experienced during migration?

Attached: SableTech_Q2_usage_report.csv (hourly exports, anonymized).

We'd like to close this quickly — procurement is asking for a final invoice and PO guidance by the first week of July.

Thanks,
Luke Emerson
Head of Platform Engineering
SableTech
[Attachment: SableTech_Q2_usage_report.csv (8 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Luke Emerson <luke.emerson@sabletech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q2 burst — need reconciliation and proposed fix

Thanks for the detail, Luke — appreciate you sending the usage export. I've reviewed the CSV and discussed with our ops team; preliminary notes below and a proposed path forward.

Summary of findings:
- Verified spike: sustained between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-18, ~38% over committed GPU-hours.
- Root-cause candidates: (a) a job misconfiguration at SableTech increasing parallelism after deploy, (b) short-lived model tuning loop that amplified token usage.

Proposed remediation (one-time + optional commit change):
1) One-time top-up invoice to cover the delta usage hours at standard overage rates (we'll provide a line-item PDF).
2) Goodwill credit: Redwood proposes a 20% one-time credit on the overage line as a partial concession while we jointly investigate operational causes.
3) Optional: If SableTech signs a 3-month commit extension at a blended discounted rate (5% below list) we will waive the invoice processing fee and apply a further 5% credit to the overage amount.

Next steps I suggest:
- I will attach a draft one-off invoice for the overage amount (see attachment).
- Naomi/Finance: can you confirm whether we can apply the 20% concession and whether we need a formal credit memo or just a one-line adjustment on the invoice?
- Luke: if the terms above sound reasonable, confirm and we'll issue the final invoice with PO instructions.

I've attached a draft invoice (REDWOOD_draft_oneoff_invoice_789.pdf) for internal review — amounts are estimates pending final reconciliation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0193
[Attachment: REDWOOD_draft_oneoff_invoice_789.pdf (PDF, 26 KB)]
